verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox or isolated test environment that keeps an agent away from production data. The nearby features are related but different controls, so none of them count toward this story. Cloning a thread copies the conversation, not the data environment. Explore mode is read-only Q&A, and tool-approval deny mode and directory-access prompts are permission gates rather than sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
